name: Puyo
author: Shigeki Karita
description: A Puyo Puyo-style falling puzzle: stack the falling blobs and link four of the same color to pop them and trigger chains.

descriptions.en: A Puyo Puyo-style falling puzzle: stack the falling blobs and link four of the same color to pop them and trigger chains.
descriptions.it: Un puzzle in stile Puyo Puyo: impila le gelatine che cadono e collegane quattro dello stesso colore per farle scoppiare e creare catene.
